title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers
summary: For every fixed integer s ≥ 6, we determine the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number: $`\displaystyle r(s,t)=\frac{t^{s-1}}{(\log t)^{s-2+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$
family_title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers

review.reason: Determines the sharp logarithmic exponent of fixed off-diagonal Ramsey numbers.
